claim: Single completion evidence has one canonical host builder shared by normal TurnOutcome finalization and Trace. Successful and failed/aborted server turns persist the same task/attempt-bound record in Session and expose it in TurnStats/TurnFailed.
limitations: No Cargo compilation, Rust tests, TypeScript tests, clippy, or runtime migration was run.
Session stores only the latest Single completion record.
Single and Team candidate-version schemas and lifecycle scopes remain distinct.
CLI/TUI and desktop currently render completion status but not receipt details.
regression_source: Trace builder filters Accepted evidence and includes accepted prior writes for this attempt
SQLite completion record round-trip and fork isolation
protocol TurnFailed legacy default and completion-record round-trip
CLI/TUI tolerate optional TurnFailed completion record
TypeScript failed terminal event preserves completion record
verification: Rust syntax parser accepted affected Rust files; no cargo command was run
